projectContext: yt-dlp browser impersonation bypass sprint. Tier 1 is COMPLETE: ImpersonationManager (auto-detect, round-robin), ImpersonationConfig, wired into all 8 call sites (core.py x2, audio_first.py x3, title_filter.py, speech_screening.py, caption_fetcher.py). Tier 2 config is COMPLETE: ExtractorArgsConfig dataclass, EscalationTier enum, EscalationState dataclass (all in src/downloader/types.py and src/config/sections/download.py). This sprint builds the EscalationManager that orchestrates 3-tier bypass progression, integrates escalation into actual download retry loops, adds 403 detection patterns, metrics/logging, healer integration, and comprehensive tests. curl_cffi 0.13.0 installed with 31 targets available.

userStories.title: Create EscalationManager class for 3-tier bypass orchestration
userStories.notes: Created EscalationManager in src/downloader/escalation_manager.py with per-keyword EscalationState tracking, get_escalation_args() returning EscalationResult (args + tier + rotate_cookies flag), record_failure/record_success, thread-safe per-keyword locks. Exported from __init__.py. All 6 acceptance criteria verified with end-to-end and thread safety tests.
acceptanceCriteria: EscalationManager class in src/downloader/escalation_manager.py with per-keyword EscalationState tracking via dict[str, EscalationState]
get_escalation_args(keyword) method returns list of yt-dlp args for current tier (Tier 1: --impersonate only, Tier 2: + --extractor-args, Tier 3: + cookie rotation flag)
record_failure(keyword, error_output) increments consecutive_403s on EscalationState and calls escalate() when threshold reached
record_success(keyword) resets 403 counter but keeps tier sticky (no de-escalation mid-session)
Constructor accepts ImpersonationManager and ExtractorArgsConfig, delegates Tier 1 args to ImpersonationManager.get_impersonate_args()
Thread-safe: uses threading.Lock per keyword for concurrent download access

Tier 2/3 args and rotate_cookies flag all wired in get_escalation_args(). Empty player_clients edge case handled at line 154-155. All 5 AC verified programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria: _build_extractor_args(state) generates ['--extractor-args', 'youtube:player_client=X,Y,Z'] from ExtractorArgsConfig.player_clients
Player client list rotates starting position using state.extractor_args_index (increments on each Tier 2 escalation)
Tier 2 get_escalation_args() returns impersonation args + extractor-args in correct yt-dlp ordering
Tier 3 get_escalation_args() returns all Tier 2 args plus a rotate_cookies=True flag in a result tuple/dataclass
Handles edge case: empty player_clients list returns no extractor-args (Tier 2 same as Tier 1)

userStories.title: Add cooldown timer and state reset to EscalationManager
userStories.notes: Added _should_escalate(state) with cooldown check using ExtractorArgsConfig.cooldown_seconds (default 300s). Added get_cooldown_remaining(keyword), reset_keyword(keyword), reset_all(). Updated record_failure() to use _should_escalate() instead of state.should_escalate() directly. All 5 AC verified programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Cooldown timer prevents re-escalation within ExtractorArgsConfig.cooldown_seconds (default 300s) per keyword
Internal _should_escalate(state) returns False during cooldown even if 403 threshold reached
get_cooldown_remaining(keyword) returns seconds remaining for logging (0.0 if not in cooldown)
reset_keyword(keyword) clears all EscalationState for a keyword (for healer or manual recovery)
reset_all() clears entire keyword state dict (for session restart)

userStories.title: Add is_escalation_trigger() helper for 403/bot-detection pattern matching
userStories.notes: Added is_escalation_trigger(stderr_output) function with compiled regex (_ESCALATION_TRIGGER_RE) matching 6 patterns: HTTP Error 403, Sign in to confirm, bot, captcha, blocked, verify you are human. Case-insensitive via re.IGNORECASE. Separate from ERROR_SEVERITY_PATTERNS in core.py (unchanged). Exported at module level from __init__.py. All 5 AC verified programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria: is_escalation_trigger(stderr_output) function in src/downloader/escalation_manager.py returns True when output matches 403/bot patterns
Patterns include: 'HTTP Error 403', 'Sign in to confirm', 'bot', 'captcha', 'blocked', 'verify you are human'
Pattern matching is case-insensitive using re.IGNORECASE
Existing ERROR_SEVERITY_PATTERNS in core.py preserved unchanged - escalation triggers are a separate concern
Function exported at module level for use by core.py, audio_first.py, and tests

userStories.title: Integrate EscalationManager into core.py download retry loop
userStories.notes: Integrated EscalationManager into VideoDownloader in core.py. __init__ creates EscalationManager from ImpersonationManager + ExtractorArgsConfig (line 309), shared with audio_first pipeline. New _add_escalation_to_cmd() method (line 753) replaces direct impersonation in keyword search+download (line 1627) and ID-based download (line 1724). Retry loop records failures via is_escalation_trigger() + record_failure() (line 1939-1940). Success path calls record_success() (line 2051). Tier 3 triggers cookie_rotator.rotate() for cookie rotation (line 1944). All 109 downloader tests pass (4 pre-existing failures unrelated).
acceptanceCriteria: VideoDownloader.__init__ creates EscalationManager from config (ImpersonationManager + ExtractorArgsConfig) and stores as self.escalation_manager
Keyword search+download (~line 1517) calls escalation_manager.get_escalation_args(keyword) instead of direct impersonation_manager.get_impersonate_args()
ID-based download (~line 1617) calls escalation_manager.get_escalation_args(video_id) instead of direct impersonation args
On subprocess returncode != 0 with is_escalation_trigger(stderr)==True, calls record_failure() before retry
On successful download (returncode == 0), calls record_success() to reset 403 counter
Tier 3 cookie rotation flag triggers existing CookieRotator.rotate_on_errors() call

userStories.title: Integrate EscalationManager into audio_first.py download commands
userStories.notes: Added escalation_manager parameter to AudioFirstPipeline.__init__ (optional, backward-compatible). New _add_escalation_to_cmd(cmd, video_id) method uses EscalationManager when available, falls back to _add_impersonation_to_cmd(). All 3 download sites updated: audio download (line 330), segment download (line 535), full video fallback (line 690). Each site: (1) uses _add_escalation_to_cmd instead of _add_impersonation_to_cmd, (2) handles Tier 3 rotate_cookies flag, (3) records success via record_success(), (4) detects 403/bot via is_escalation_trigger() and calls record_failure(). Core.py already shares escalation_manager at line 314. All 19 escalation tests pass, 119/122 downloader tests pass (3 pre-existing failures in test_stage_download unrelated).
acceptanceCriteria: AudioFirstPipeline.__init__ accepts optional escalation_manager parameter (passed from VideoDownloader)
Audio download (~line 241) uses escalation_manager.get_escalation_args(video_id) when available
Segment download (~line 427) uses escalation_manager.get_escalation_args(video_id) when available
Full video fallback (~line 591) uses escalation_manager.get_escalation_args(video_id) when available

403 errors detected via is_escalation_trigger() trigger record_failure() before retry

userStories.title: Integrate EscalationManager into auxiliary downloaders
userStories.notes: Added optional escalation_manager parameter to TitleFilter, SpeechScreener, and CaptionFetcher __init__ (all backward-compatible). TitleFilter.search_video_metadata() uses get_escalation_args(keyword) for --dump-json calls. SpeechScreener.download_audio_clip() uses get_escalation_args(video_id) for audio downloads. CaptionFetcher adds _add_bypass_args_to_cmd() helper used in all 6 yt-dlp call sites (list_available_languages, _fetch_subtitle_with_format, is_live_stream, get_stream_state, get_video_metadata, and batch_precheck). All three fall back to impersonation_manager when escalation_manager is None. VideoDownloader shares self.escalation_manager with title_filter and speech_screener at init. CaptionStage creates its own EscalationManager for CaptionFetcher. All 81 caption tests pass, 143/147 downloader tests pass (4 pre-existing failures unrelated).

SpeechScreener.__init__ accepts optional escalation_manager, uses get_escalation_args() for audio clip downloads
CaptionFetcher accepts optional escalation_manager, uses get_escalation_args() for --list-subs and caption downloads

Added _total_403s, _total_successes, _total_escalations, _escalations_per_tier counters to EscalationManager tracked in record_failure/record_success. INFO/WARNING/DEBUG logging was already present from US-001. Added set_escalation_metrics() to HealingOrchestrator and BYPASS ESCALATION section to print_report(). Added _collect_escalation_metrics() helper in pipeline.py to wire metrics from DownloadStage's downloader to orchestrator before print_report(). All 5 AC verified programmatically.
acceptanceCriteria: EscalationManager.get_metrics() returns dict: total_escalations, escalations_per_tier, keywords_at_each_tier, total_403s, total_successes, average_tier
Log at INFO on escalation: 'Escalation: keyword={kw} tier {old}->{new} after {n} consecutive 403s'
Log at WARNING on max tier: 'Max escalation reached for keyword={kw}, engaging full bypass'

Pipeline end-of-run summary includes escalation metrics alongside existing impersonation stats

userStories.title: Add unit tests for EscalationManager core logic
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_escalation_manager.py with 40 tests across 7 test classes: TestTierProgression (6 tests), TestEscalationArgs (6 tests), TestCooldown (5 tests), TestPerKeywordIsolation (5 tests), TestThreadSafety (4 tests), TestIsEscalationTrigger (8 parametrized tests), TestMetrics (2 tests). All 6 acceptance criteria covered. Time mocking patches both src.downloader.escalation_manager.time and src.downloader.types.time for tier progression through cooldown.
acceptanceCriteria: Test file tests/test_escalation_manager.py with pytest and --non-interactive support
Test tier progression: record_failure() x threshold triggers escalate(), advancing Tier 1->2->3
Test get_escalation_args() returns correct args per tier (Tier 1: impersonate only, Tier 2: + extractor-args, Tier 3: + cookie flag)
Test cooldown: escalation suppressed during cooldown period, allowed after expiry (mock time.time())
Test per-keyword isolation: keyword_a at Tier 3 does not affect keyword_b at Tier 1
Test thread safety: concurrent get_escalation_args() calls from multiple threads do not corrupt state
